topic: Ambient Lamp Control Logic and Fault Handling
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific control command or fault handling scenario for the ambient lamp system.
column_semantics: The first column categorizes the type of entry (e.g., control commands, fault handling), while the second column provides detailed descriptions of the corresponding behavior or action.

core_entities.name: Ambient Lamp
core_entities.description: The lighting system that provides ambient illumination inside the vehicle.

core_entities.name: ZCU
core_entities.description: Zone Control Unit, responsible for managing various vehicle functions including lighting.

core_conditions.name: UpIPALampBrthngCmd_1
core_conditions.description: Command to control breathing mode of the ambient lamp. Value 0x00 indicates no request to exit breathing mode.

core_conditions.name: UpIPALampBrtNsCmd_1
core_conditions.description: Brightness command for the ambient lamp.

core_conditions.name: UpIPALampColorCmd_1
core_conditions.description: Color command for the ambient lamp.

core_conditions.name: UpIPALampFadeSpdCmd_1
core_conditions.description: Fade speed command for the ambient lamp.

core_conditions.name: AmbtLghtRHRollingCtr_1
core_conditions.description: Rolling control command for the ambient lamp's breathing mode.

core_conditions.name: LIN Signal from ZCU
core_conditions.description: Communication signal from the Zone Control Unit over the LIN bus.

core_outputs.name: Breathing Mode
core_outputs.description: A dynamic lighting pattern where the lamp brightness changes rhythmically.

core_outputs.name: Constant Brightness Display
core_outputs.description: The ambient lamp displays a steady brightness level without any dynamic changes.

core_outputs.name: Static On
core_outputs.description: The ambient lamp remains on at a fixed brightness level.

core_outputs.name: Ambient Lamp Off
core_outputs.description: The ambient lamp is turned off as a safety measure.

core_faults.name: Overvoltage/Undervoltage
core_faults.description: Fault condition detected in the ambient lamp module due to abnormal voltage levels.

core_faults.name: LIN Communication Timeout
core_faults.description: Failure to receive LIN signal from ZCU within a specified time period.

core_timing_constraints.name: 6s
core_timing_constraints.description: Default timeout period for receiving LIN signal from ZCU before triggering a fault response.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the operational logic for controlling the ambient lamp's breathing mode and constant brightness display, as well as the fault handling procedures for voltage faults and LIN communication timeouts.
